title: Give people honest scales. Please stay consistent.
text: Give people honest scales. Please stay consistent.. I was so disappointed because I had a great experience purchasing one of these for my bed, and this time around I got half the fill. I loved mine so I bought my daughter one, and the grey color is so light compared to their very charcoal grey picture. I left it out to fluff, but it never did. So disappointed that it was such a skimpy blanket. There is a significant difference between the two I purchased.
